archetypes.name: dyn-oos-aggregation
archetypes.rationale: Aggregate OOS promotion depends on severity, identity, and security filtering staying aligned.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed OOS pool accumulation and promotion helpers in design_oos.py, plan_review_tally.py, and review_tally.py. Focus on whether public non-security candidates are counted once, whether important/blocking and three-latent triggers use body severity, and whether promoted FINDING blocks become OOS headers without duplicating accepted items. Check sentinel ordering around design file-oos prepare. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
